long_biography.plain_text:
Baker Bros. Advisors approaches drug development as both a scientific question and an investment problem. Felix Baker's immunology training informs a research-led method that examines the science behind prospective medicines, builds positions over time and concentrates capital where the firm sees durable value.

The firm's capital has also placed Baker inside companies it backs. He has served on biotechnology boards including Seagen, Kodiak Sciences, Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals and Kymera Therapeutics. Since June 2025, he has chaired Bicycle Therapeutics, an oncology-focused drug developer, while remaining a managing member of Baker Bros. Advisors.
